name: How Are You Paying Today?
source:
In this grocery store, everything has a price. Navigate the aisles, manage your sanity and strength, meet strange people, and try to leave with your groceries.

Make it back home – if you can.

[From [url=https://knightanni.itch.io/how-are-you-paying-today]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这家杂货店里，所有东西都有价格。在过道中穿行，管理你的理智和体力，遇到陌生的人，并尝试带着你的杂货离开。

如果可以的话，让它回家吧。

[来自[url=https://knightanni.itch.io/how-are-you-paying-today]Itch.io[/url]]
